Select approved drugs indicated for chronic kidney disease. Join drug_indication to molecule_dictionary on molregno. Join compound_structures on molregno as an INNER JOIN. Filter where max_phase_for_ind equals 4 and mesh_heading equals 'chronic kidney disease'. Return chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, efo_id as indication_curie, efo_term as indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind. Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie, indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind.
